content.short: ApeWorx EVM Trace is a Python-based Ethereum Virtual Machine transaction tracing tool.
content.description: ApeWorx EVM Trace is a Python-based tracing tool for Geth- and Parity-style tests, delivering gas usage data and a detailed call-tree that helps developers analyze execution flow. Developers can pip install the EVM Trace quickstart to set up a Python testing environment and run tests directly in Python, or contribute their own tests to the project to broaden its capabilities. The repository has +100 forks, stars, and contributors.
